metadata.case_name: WONG KIN HUNG v. CHAN WAI MING

plaintiff.occupation_after: Gardener (found work as a gardener around January 2005) (in addition to driving a taxi now and then)

source: Dr. Lam said the Plaintiff "only had a minor head and neck injury…The injuries should have recovered within a short time."

There were tender areas over right side of head, neck and right leg. Haematoma was noted over right side of head. X-rays of head, neck, chest and right leg showed no fracture. He was discharged after observation.
injuries.icd_description: Contusion of other or unspecified sites of head

source: Both doctors agreed that "(T)he right leg had a simple contusion only, which should have recovered already."
pain over upper tibia of right knee when he lay on his left side. The pain lasted 1-2 minutes and woke him up 3-4 nights per month.

manifestations.description: aching discomfort over the left side of his neck every day (neck pain)
right-sided headache associated with his neck pain
haematoma over right side of head
tenderness over the tibial tuberosity on the right knee
pain over upper tibia of right knee when lying on left side (woke him 3-4 nights per month)

treatments_received: Accident and Emergency attendance and observation at Pamela Youde Nethersole Eastern Hospital on 19 May 2004
Follow-up attendances on 26 May 2004, 2 June 2004, 9 June 2004 and 16 June 2004
Attendance at PYNEH on 25 November 2004 (neck sprain)
treatments_future: 30 sessions of physiotherapy recommended by Dr. Au (would take 6 weeks and cost $10,000 in the private sector)

losses.description: Pain, suffering and loss of amenities awarded under general damages

comparable_cases.case_name: Chan Siu Youn v Ng Kam Man and others
comparable_cases.injury_description: sprain neck injury; hospitalized the same day and treated with physiotherapy, neck collar and analgesic; discharged 2 days later; attended Orthopaedics Department for follow-up treatment lasting more than a year; still suffered from intermittent residual neck pain
